layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Insectivore diet symbolism
features: A playful assortment of clay insects to represent an insectivorous diet
A plump, metallic-blue clay beetle with a segmented shell
A bright red clay dragonfly with delicate, translucent-looking clay wings
A long-legged brown crane fly and a grey mosquito with a soft, rounded proboscis
All insects have large, friendly white-and-black clay eyes
The insects are resting on a large, vibrant green clay leaf with simple vein patterns
layer_3_action.action: A centered, slightly overhead shot of the clay insects on a leaf. The lighting is bright and cheerful, highlighting the tactile, 'squishy' look of the clay. This serves as a clear indicator for an insect-eating diet in a children's game. No text.
